citation: Lai Y, Ramírez-Pardo I, Isern J, An J, Perdiguero E, et al. (2024). Multimodal cell atlas of the ageing human skeletal muscle. Nature 629:154-164.

preferential loss of type IIX myonuclei
profibrotic TGF-beta signaling peaks in individuals >=84y
